name: timestamp
description: Observation timestamp (datetime, 30-min nominal interval)

name: equipment_id
description: Equipment identifier (e.g., CHILLER-01) - discovered dynamically

name: Chilled Water Rate (L/sec)
description: Chilled water flow rate in liters per second (imputed where missing)

name: Cooling Water Temperature (C)
description: Cooling water temperature in Celsius (imputed where missing)

name: Building Load (RT)
description: Building cooling load in refrigeration tons (imputed where missing)

name: Chiller Energy Consumption (kWh)
description: Chiller energy consumption in kWh - primary energy target (imputed where missing)

name: Outside Temperature (F)
description: Outside ambient temperature in Fahrenheit

name: Dew Point (F)
description: Dew point temperature in Fahrenheit

name: Humidity (%)
description: Relative humidity percentage (imputed where missing)

name: Wind Speed (mph)
description: Wind speed in miles per hour (imputed where missing)

name: Pressure (in)
description: Atmospheric pressure in inches of mercury (imputed where missing)

name: Chilled Water Rate (L/sec)_was_missing
description: True if the original Chilled Water Rate value was missing and was imputed

name: Cooling Water Temperature (C)_was_missing
description: True if the original Cooling Water Temperature value was missing and was imputed

name: Building Load (RT)_was_missing
description: True if the original Building Load value was missing and was imputed

name: Chiller Energy Consumption (kWh)_was_missing
description: True if the original Energy Consumption value was missing and was imputed

name: Humidity (%)_was_missing
description: True if the original Humidity value was missing and was imputed

name: Wind Speed (mph)_was_missing
description: True if the original Wind Speed value was missing and was imputed

name: Pressure (in)_was_missing
description: True if the original Pressure value was missing and was imputed

name: time_since_last_obs_minutes
description: Minutes since the previous observation for this equipment (NaN for first row)

name: is_post_gap
description: True if this row follows a gap longer than 45 minutes - a data feature, NOT an anomaly indicator

name: gap_group_id
description: Contiguous block ID per equipment - increments after gaps > 24h, used for rolling window segmentation

name: efficiency_ratio
description: Energy consumption per unit load (kWh/RT) - NaN if load < 10 RT to guard against division by near-zero

name: energy_roll_mean_3h
description: 3-hour rolling mean of energy consumption (per equipment, gap-aware)

name: energy_roll_std_3h
description: 3-hour rolling standard deviation of energy consumption (per equipment, gap-aware)

name: eff_roll_mean_3h
description: 3-hour rolling mean of efficiency ratio (per equipment, gap-aware)

name: eff_roll_std_3h
description: 3-hour rolling standard deviation of efficiency ratio (per equipment, gap-aware)

name: energy_roll_mean_24h
description: 24-hour rolling mean of energy consumption (per equipment, gap-aware)

name: energy_roll_std_24h
description: 24-hour rolling standard deviation of energy consumption (per equipment, gap-aware)

name: eff_roll_mean_24h
description: 24-hour rolling mean of efficiency ratio (per equipment, gap-aware)

name: eff_roll_std_24h
description: 24-hour rolling standard deviation of efficiency ratio (per equipment, gap-aware)

name: energy_lag_1
description: Energy consumption at t-1 (30 minutes prior, same equipment, does not cross gap boundaries)

name: energy_lag_2
description: Energy consumption at t-2 (60 minutes prior, same equipment, does not cross gap boundaries)

name: hour_of_day
description: Hour of the day (0-23) extracted from timestamp

name: day_of_week
description: Day of the week (0=Monday, 6=Sunday) extracted from timestamp

name: month
description: Month of the year (1-12) extracted from timestamp

name: is_daytime
description: True if observation falls within daytime hours (06:00-18:00)

name: energy_zscore
description: Z-score of energy consumption against this equipment's own 7-day rolling baseline (not global stats)

name: efficiency_zscore
description: Z-score of efficiency ratio against this equipment's own 7-day rolling baseline (not global stats)
